title: Entitled listing and aggregate cap
lede: Ping release claim (2026-11-02), UNVERIFIED on our tenant. A caller asks the gateway what it may use and gets only its own tools; a hidden tool is refused when called by name; the aggregate's policy cap is checked on the list and again at the member hop.

nodes.label: Caller
sub: Asks tools/list, then calls a tool by name
nodes.prevents: A caller learning about tools it may not use.

nodes.label: Gateway: entitlement filter
sub: Removes tools the caller may not use, and refuses them by name
nodes.prevents: A tool the caller is not entitled to being offered, or being usable by guessing its name.

nodes.label: Aggregate: policy cap
sub: alias__tool names. The cap limits every member tool
nodes.prevents: A member tool being used beyond what the aggregate's policy allows.

nodes.label: Member hop
sub: Cap and member policy checked again before forwarding
nodes.prevents: A stale list or a routing slip getting a call past the cap.

nodes.label: Member MCP server
sub: Used directly, only its own policy applies
nodes.prevents: Confusing the aggregate's rules with the member's own: used directly, the member follows only its own policy.

nodes.label: Unreachable member
sub: Reported to the caller, not dropped
nodes.prevents: An outage looking like 'no tools here'.

steps.title: Ask what you may use
steps.what: The caller asks the gateway what it may use. (Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant: simulated in Mock, measured in Real.)

steps.title: Only your tools come back
steps.what: The reply holds only the tools this caller is entitled to, named alias__tool. The aggregate's policy caps what any member tool may be used for. Nothing says what was left out.

steps.title: A down member is reported
steps.what: A member that cannot be reached is reported in the reply, not silently dropped.

steps.title: A call by name is checked again
steps.what: A call by name is checked again, so a hidden tool is refused when it is called, not only left off the list.

steps.title: The member hop checks twice
steps.what: At the member hop the cap and the member's own policy are checked a second time, then the call is forwarded.
